beneficiary: MONTREAL.AI scientific opportunity research and collaborators evaluating what to measure next
blindness: Separate evaluator process and paths under the same administrator. Release historical public case files after the candidates are frozen.
data_partition: Three development cases from the paper, one explicitly labeled missing-input development fixture. Held paper cases use other target ids. Fresh archive cases use distinct ids from the paper cohort and differ in source format. Independently predict census for the complete released paper table. Keep all confirmation out of constructor packets.
experimental_arms: local direct with compact field key and ordinary tool access
same local model with version 1.1 HARNESS construction framing and same task/evidence
same local model with typed, named evidence and same task/evidence
current included Codex as a single human-assisted packet transport and artifact build, without independent frontier-provider comparison
materiality: Require at least two confirmed additional accepted cases and no extra unsupported non-abstention compared with direct and existing HARNESS, with exact source/case parity. Require accepted fresh archive outcomes; do not upgrade cross-domain generalization from a single related domain. No progress from packaging alone.
method: First linear-model midpoint at or after the supplied BJD_TDB anchor, including negative epochs when appropriate. Bound propagated standard deviation under unknown covariance using only source marginal standard deviations. Report an outward rounded integer-second interval. Decide using unrounded quantities. This is a bound on model standard deviation rather than a confidence window.
objective: Audit which published linear transit ephemerides support a timing uncertainty target across unknown covariance, before allocating measurement work.
same_model_condition: One model configuration per comparison, same underlying evidence, one full initial request per arm, separate preregistered repair only if feasible and disclosed. Candidate semantic arm must receive and use named field representation; delivery alone does not prove use. The same program executes on two shape-correct equivalent views.

alternatives: ephemeris uncertainty triage across two scientific sources
selection.reason: A different physical question combines heterogeneous source records, named time basis, hours versus days, uncertainty with missing covariance, evidence witnesses and reproducible intervention opportunities.
selection.selected: exoplanet ephemeris decision from scientific publication and a second live archive format

archive.role: independent input-format transfer, not independent observations or a new ephemeris fit
archive.version: snapshot retrieved 2026-11-24 UTC; use only compact attributed measurements and hashes

publication.license: CC BY 4.0, attribution Kokori et al. (2026), ApJS 283, 5, 10.3847/1538-4365/ae3238

stop: Freeze thresholds before scoring; retain failed runs. Candidate execution stays inside qualified native isolation. Do not promote a new model or spend money. Reuse exact conventional solution if it wins.
threshold: At most duration_hours / 12 converted to seconds. Nominal source duration; no duration-error propagation into the threshold.
